scripts.demo: npm run build --workspace @localwebauthn/demo && npm run start --workspace @localwebauthn/demo
scripts.check:packages: npm run build && publint packages/server && publint packages/browser && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/server && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/browser
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run check:packages
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @localwebauthn/server && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @localwebauthn/browser
